question: How should the invocation of the goddess be performed ritually?
premises: Invocation is to be performed after the contemplation.
It is done with the gāyatrī together with the head mantra.
inference: One should then perform the invocation using the gāyatrī together with the head mantra.
plain_english: Then one should perform the invocation with the gāyatrī together with the head mantra.
